config.mathematics: Both source and target encode every coordinate of a continuous [0,1]^n cube with objective sum x. Strict: one caller-bound positive predicate P=sum x and a complete all-zero output tuple, every source bound checked, exact objective margin P. This proves strict improvement for every P>0 while preserving the strict boundary. Image: a complete feasible source point x_i=2/3 and a full identity affine map; exactly the last target upper bound is 1/2, so the complete mapped point violates that actual target bound. No containment claim, partial tuple or missing domain is substituted.
config.sampling: Absolute capability baseline, no speed ratio against older versions that lack these tasks. Fresh processes, nine verify samples and three independent /usr/bin/time -l RSS samples. Exact logical statistics must match; all non-VERIFIED exits, missing RSS and mismatches are retained as failures. Warm filesystem cache after preparation; no cache flush.
config.preparation: Three fresh independent Python processes generate complete MCM bytes, RPA and caller requests, followed by production RPA assembly. Report internal generation, full generation+assembly process wall, all byte sizes, decode, execute, full kernel wall and RSS. No MPS canonicalization cost is implied for direct synthetic MCM generation.
config.isolation: Official measurements wait for coordinator clear and an explicit recorded isolation note. Non-isolated mathematical diagnostics are saved separately and excluded from official timing. The prior subflow workload manifest is unchanged.

isolation_note: Continuation of the root-cleared sequential capability window after subflow completed. Root and corpus remain computationally idle; model edits small reports only. No other owned heavy task overlaps these samples.
cache: Warm after generation/assembly, independent process per sample, no cache flush
